title: FollowupEntry
description: A follow-up registry entry (schema_version = 1). See SPEC.md §Entry-schema.

sink.description: Storage sink. Notion is a passive mirror, never a primary sink.

created_by_run.description: Run ID that created this entry

capture_head.description: git commit SHA at creation time

source_artifact.description: Path of the artifact (diff, task file, etc.) that prompted creation

prompt_page_link.description: Relative path to the prompt page markdown file

recommended_command.description: The /z-* command to execute. Must start with /z- followed by kebab-case word(s).

recommended_command_safe_to_retry.description: Whether the recommended command is idempotent / safe to retry

cited_paths.description: File paths this follow-up is concerned with (max 16; use dir_blob_hashes for larger sets)

depth.description: Nesting depth: 0 = mainline, 1 = spawned inside a consumer execution

auto_close_eligible.description: Whether this entry qualifies for the auto-close-low-risk path

completion_mode.description: How this entry was completed. Null while not yet done.

audit_evidence_path.description: Path to audit evidence JSON blob (null until audit_confirmed)

closed_by_run.description: Run ID that closed this entry (null while not yet closed)

failure_reason.description: Human-readable reason for failure or block (null when not failed/blocked)

attempt_count.description: Number of execution attempts (incremented on failed transitions)

notion_remote_id.description: Notion page ID for the mirrored page (null if Notion disabled or not yet pushed)

file_blob_hashes.description: Map of path -> sha256:<hex> blob hash for cited files (null when dir_blob_hashes is used)

dir_blob_hashes.description: Map of ancestor dir -> sha256:<hex> tree hash (null when file_blob_hashes is used)

blob_hashes_mutex.description: Exactly one of file_blob_hashes / dir_blob_hashes must be non-null and non-empty. sink-add always sets exactly one; neither-set is not a valid state.

allOf.description: At most one may be non-null (mutual exclusion).
At least one must be non-null and non-empty (neither-set is rejected).

file_blob_hashes.description: Map of path -> sha256:<hex> blob hash for cited files (must have at least 1 entry)

dir_blob_hashes.description: Map of ancestor dir -> sha256:<hex> tree hash (used when cited_paths > 16; must have at least 1 entry)
